02 / THE STUDIO

A different perspective
is a beginning.

Metaversal Arts is the independent creative practice of Roger Bootsma in Vienna. Bringing together 3D animation, procedural systems and immersive worlds, it explores the space where artistic intuition meets technical possibility.
